security_audit.summary: The audit adjudicated all 400 static findings. Most command-execution, URL, reconnaissance, and screen-capture matches are documentation false positives. Confirmed risks include credential-bearing cookie storage and default cloud backup, proxy-assisted account creation, detection-evasive social automation, webhook output delivery, and predictable temporary files. Static review was capped at 400/654 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 254 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Social session cookies are backed up remotely by default.
remediation.suggestion: Make backup opt-in, encrypt cookies client-side, require secure server storage, and show explicit consent before every credential upload.

remediation.issue: Reusable session cookies are stored in predictable files under the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Use the operating system credential store or encrypted files with strict permissions and clear rotation and revocation controls.

remediation.issue: Account creation guidance uses throwaway mailboxes and residential proxies to avoid shadowbans.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automated signup and enforcement-evasion guidance. Limit the skill to user-owned accounts created through normal platform flows.

remediation.issue: Social automation includes detection-evasive messaging, engagement, and recurring autopilot schedules.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval for each write, enforce hard rate limits, prohibit unsolicited bulk outreach, and remove advice about avoiding detection.

remediation.issue: Scheduled command output can be delivered to arbitrary webhooks.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict destinations, redact credentials and private content, require confirmation, and provide an auditable preview before sending output.

remediation.issue: Examples use predictable filenames in the shared temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private per-run directory with restrictive permissions, verify file ownership, and remove it after the workflow completes.

content.user_title: Create and Automate Media with Wonda CLI
content.value_statement: Creating and distributing media across several tools takes time and coordination. This skill guides Wonda CLI workflows for generation, editing, research, publishing, and automation.
actual_capabilities: Generate images, videos, text, music, speech, and dialogue with supported Wonda models.
Edit, compose, caption, merge, clip, transcribe, and analyze media through local and hosted workflows.
Extract brand assets and reuse saved brand settings across content projects.
Research public content and account activity on LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and Instagram.
Publish content and perform approved social actions through connected accounts.
Manage browser personas, cloud twins, schedules, organizations, projects, usage, and spend context.
limitations: Most remote features require a paid Wonda plan, account authentication, and available credits.
Local editing requires compatible versions of ffmpeg, Node.js, and Chromium components.
Social features depend on third-party platform interfaces and may stop working after platform changes.
Automated social actions can trigger account restrictions and may conflict with platform rules.

use_cases.title: Produce campaign assets
use_cases.description: Generate branded images, short videos, speech, music, and captions for a reviewed marketing campaign.

use_cases.title: Finish videos locally
use_cases.description: Download media, trim scenes, merge clips, replace audio, and export delivery-ready files with local tools.

use_cases.title: Research social conversations
use_cases.description: Collect public posts and engagement signals before drafting content or planning manual outreach.

prompt_templates.title: Create a social image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one 9:16 campaign image for [product]. Use the active brand. Show the estimated cost and wait for approval before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Edit a product video
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [video file]. Trim the requested section, add approved captions, preserve the source aspect ratio, and export an MP4 locally.

prompt_templates.title: Research a campaign topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] on LinkedIn, X, and Reddit. Use read-only commands and summarize recurring themes, objections, and cited public examples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a reviewed launch workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-step launch for [campaign]. Generate assets, estimate spend, use dry runs, and request explicit approval before every publish or social write.

output_examples.input: Create a vertical product teaser with captions.
output_examples.output: A 9:16 teaser plan with the selected model, prompt, estimated cost, caption style, local finishing steps, and approval checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Research recent discussion about AI video tools.
output: A summary of recurring themes across selected platforms.
A list of public examples with source platform and author.
Suggested content angles without automated engagement.

output_examples.input: Turn a long interview into three short clips.
output_examples.output: Three proposed clip ranges with hooks, speaker context, caption language, reframe method, and final export locations.

best_practices: Confirm the active account, organization, project, budget, and output path before starting paid work.
Use read-only commands and dry runs first, then require explicit approval before publishing or messaging.
Disable automatic cookie backup and store authentication material in an encrypted system credential store.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys, passwords, session cookies, or private messages into prompts, logs, or shared outputs.
Do not create accounts, vary messages, or use proxies to evade platform anti-abuse systems.
Do not place sensitive media in predictable shared temporary paths.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Wonda account?
faq.answer: Yes. Most generation, research, publishing, and cloud features require authentication and a paid plan.

faq.question: Can it edit media without remote rendering?
faq.answer: Yes. Many deterministic editing and composition workflows run locally with ffmpeg, Node.js, and Chromium.

faq.question: Can it publish to social platforms?
faq.answer: Yes, through connected accounts. Every publish or social write should require explicit user approval.

faq.question: Does it store social session cookies?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented browser workflows persist cookies locally and can back them up remotely.

faq.question: Can it automate social engagement?
faq.answer: Yes. This capability carries account, consent, spam, and platform-policy risks and should remain tightly supervised.
